How this version of the Agent4Life website handles contact requests and browsing.

Contact requests.

The contact and home valuation forms prepare a message in your browser. When Google Maps address suggestions are enabled, the address you type is sent to Google to retrieve matching addresses. You may also enter the address manually. They do not submit information to Agent4Life automatically. You can review the text, copy it, save it to your device, or open it in your email app.

If you send the email, the recipient receives the information you included. Contact Agent4Life at superiorservicerealtor@gmail.com with questions about a message you have sent or to request a correction.

Browsing
and services.

This build does not include advertising trackers, analytics scripts, a newsletter subscription, or browser storage of your form details. The website host may process technical information when delivering pages.

Typography is loaded from Google Fonts, which requires a connection from your browser to Google’s servers. Links to social networks, virtual tours, or email applications take you to services with their own privacy practices.

This notice describes this version of the site. It should be updated if direct form delivery, analytics, or other services are added.
